description: Acquires and verifies selected NJDEP/DCF licensed childcare center source records with full publisher metadata as an immutable local-review release; not a national registry adapter.

output_schema_contract.verification: scripts/verify-nj-childcare.mjs takes an immutable manifest path, replays acquisition evidence and normalization, and verifies retained raw publisher XML; it does not take current.json.
output_schema_contract.postal_fields: physical_address.zip_code and postal_code contain ZIP5 only; physical_address.zip4 is a separate four-digit string or null.
output_schema_contract.geocode: Nullable latitude/longitude only on normalized entities. Internal selected features retain source point evidence; native Web Mercator 102100/latest 3857 and requested WGS84 4326 transformation remain explicit. No business polygons.

redirect_policy: Reject redirects. Only fixed production Structures MapServer/4 and /query paths, fixed public item and raw metadata.xml are requested. No caller URL, SQL or field override; do not follow embedded metadata links.
retry: At most three bounded transient attempts with header/body deadlines and one-second observation spacing. Honor publisher Retry-After; waits above 60000ms defer. No retry for cancellation, redirects, scope/schema/format drift or quality failure. CLI exposes no transport or limit override.
checkpoint: Before/after layer, item, raw XML, count, date and unique ID evidence must agree around selected batches. Retain complete JSON observations and unchanged XML bytes. This is not a transactional snapshot; acquisition resume and automatic crash recovery are not implemented.
idempotency: Immutable UUID run-scoped releases retain source evidence and hashes. No freshness reuse, business deduplication, closure detection or temporal comparison is implied; repeated explicit acquisition may access the provider again.
cancellation: Cooperative CLI signals and parent IPC abort requests, waits and precommit work. Preserve prior/sibling releases and ordinary failed staging; clean only owned staging on cooperative precommit cancellation. Publication uses an exclusive lock and a noninterruptible final commit. Abrupt termination or disk failure requires explicit inspection; no automatic stale-lock reclamation.
retention_profile: Immutable internal selected features, complete publisher metadata and source observations; local-review-only normalized records. Operator-governed deletion, no automatic cleanup.
